text:
katie-mktg: Heads-up — I ran the weekly deck and noticed launch-post engagement spiked but MQLs didn't move. Can someone sanity-check routing/UTM attribution? :eyes:
sam-growth: ugh that pattern again. My guess is inbound routing rules dropped some webinar leads into 'nurture' instead of 'sales'. Will check flows now. @diego-analytics can you confirm channel-level matchbacks?
diego-analytics: Looking at a quick snapshot: landing -> registration conversion up 48%, but MQLs +7%. Raw numbers: `registrations: 1,230`, `leads routed to sales: 92`, `expected sales-routing ~ 180` (based on baseline).
marta-ops: Can you paste the query you used? I can audit the ETL / routing logs. Might be a tag rename in the last deploy.
diego-analytics: sure — small query snippet: ```sql
SELECT utm_source, count(*) as regs, sum(case when routed_to = 'sales' then 1 else 0 end) as sales_routed
FROM inbound_events
WHERE campaign IN ('launch_posts', 'webinar_series')
  AND event_ts > '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY regs DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
reporting-bot: Weekly KPI deck uploaded: https://app.redwood.ai/dashboards/grey-matter-launch (auto) :file_folder:  (viewers: katie-mktg, sam-growth, diego-analytics)
sam-growth: thx. @marta-ops if there's a tag rename, it may explain why the dashboard filters undercount MQLs (filter expects `lead_source=launch_posts_v1`).
marta-ops: I pulled routing logs — there was a mapping change at 2026-03-14 02:12 UTC where `utm_campaign=launch-v2` was mapped to `nurture` due to a legacy regex. Rolling a fix in prod now, will backfill. :mechanical_arm:
diego-analytics: Nice catch. I'll run a backfill estimate and update the KPI slide with corrected numbers. Quick note — webinar registrants are high, but webinar -> MQL conversion historically lags by ~6 days. Don't panic immediate MQL shortfalls.
katie-mktg: Good call. For the deck text: keep the benchmark narrative as "strong engagement, routing mismatch explains short-term MQL delta; backfill and re-evaluate in 7 days." I'll patch the slide. :+1:
sam-growth: Also recommend we add a tiny card to the dashboard showing "routing fidelity" (percent of leads with route tag) so ops can catch this earlier.
marta-ops: will add a monitor alert if routing fidelity < 95% for launch campaigns.
katie-mktg: Perfect. Thanks team — can we reconvene Friday AM if the backfill shifts numbers? :coffee:
